disclaimer: Event dates, venues, and pitch competition formats change. Verify with the event organiser before booking flights.

data_availability.summary: Dubai Calendar exposes no public API: dubaicalendar.ae redirects into bot-protected visitdubai.com (Akamai returns 403 to non-browser clients), and the only official events dataset (slug dtcm_e_permits_events-open-api, now served from the apis.data.dubai gateway after the Dubai Pulse portal was decommissioned) requires OAuth credentials. This pack therefore stays curated.

venue_shift.summary: DWTC anchor shows are migrating to the expanded Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai. GITEX Global leads the move in December 2026, with Gulfood and WHX Dubai following in 2027.

events.name: Expand North Star 2026
events.operator: DWTC / Kaoun International + Dubai Chamber of Digital Economy
events.venue: Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai
events.notes: ENS dates sit inside the GITEX Global 2026 week (7 to 11 December 2026).

supernova_format.name: Supernova 0X
supernova_format.selection_note: Winners are chosen from the semi-finals; there is no separate final pitch round.

applications.scope: Supernova 0X pitch competition; not a general visitor-registration deadline.

events.name: GITEX Global 2026
events.tagline: World's largest tech and AI event
events.venue: Expo City Dubai (anchored at the Dubai Exhibition Centre)
events.notes: Confirmed 7 to 11 December 2026 at Expo City Dubai in a split-venue format. Moved from Dubai World Trade Centre for the 2026 edition; Expand North Star (8 to 10 December) runs inside the same week.

events.name: Step Dubai
events.notes: The organiser page (dubai.stepconference.com now redirects to stepconference.com/dubai/2027/) advertises 3 to 4 February 2027 at Dubai Internet City.

events.name: Dubai AI Week

edition_2026.verification_note: On 1 September 2026 the Dubai Government announced Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November 2026), which brings the Dubai Future Forum and Dubai AI Week communities together in one connected platform. The earlier 6 to 9 April 2026 dates do not establish that a standalone 2026 edition was held, and no separate AI Week days within the November week are published.

events.notes: The former event site week.dub.ai now redirects to dubaifutureweek.com. See the dubai_future_week_2026 record. The separate Dubai AI Festival advertises 26 to 27 October 2026 at DWTC.

events.name: Dubai AI Festival 2026
events.notes: The event advertises 26 to 27 October 2026 at Dubai World Trade Centre. It is separate from Dubai AI Week, which is now part of Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November 2026).

events.name: AIM Congress 2026
events.notes: The 2026 dates (7 to 9 September) have passed. The organiser site now advertises the next edition and has not published a post-event report for 2026, so attendance outcomes are not recorded here.

events.name: Dubai Fitness Challenge 2026
events.notes: 10th edition. Dubai Ride (4 km family and 12 km routes) opens the challenge on Sheikh Zayed Road on 1 November 2026 and Dubai Run (5 km and 10 km) takes over Sheikh Zayed Road on 22 November 2026. The challenge window comes from the Dubai Media Office retail calendar; the Ride and Run dates come from press coverage of the organiser announcement because dubaifitnesschallenge.com blocks automated fetches. Free, pre-registration required.

events.name: Dubai Airshow 2027
events.venue: DWC, Al Maktoum International Airport (Dubai World Central)

events.name: UN 2026 Water Conference
events.notes: UAE and Senegal co-host. Runs 8 to 10 December 2026 at the ADNEC Conference Centre in Abu Dhabi, the same week as GITEX Global at Expo City Dubai; expect heavy hotel and flight demand across both emirates.

events.name: Dubai Future Week 2026
events.tagline: For the Human of the Future
events.venue: Emirates Towers and the Museum of the Future
events.notes: Announced on 1 September 2026 under the directives of Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed. Builds on the Dubai Future Forum and Dubai AI Week and also features AI Grandmaster, the Dubai Foresight Awards, the Dubai Future Solutions: Prototypes for Humanity exhibition and TED Talks. The site offers a register-to-attend form.

events.name: Dubai Future Forum 2026
events.notes: The standalone 17 to 18 November 2026 forum dates are superseded. The official Dubai Future Forum 2026 page now redirects to Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November 2026, Emirates Towers and the Museum of the Future), which brings the Dubai Future Forum and Dubai AI Week communities together. No separate forum days within the week are published.

events.name: WETEX 2026
events.tagline: Water, Energy, Technology and Environment Exhibition

events.name: Dubai Esports and Games Festival 2026
events.notes: The 2026 festival was held 22 May to 7 June 2026 (rescheduled from the originally announced 8 to 24 May window), with GameExpo running 5 to 7 June.

events.name: Dubai Home Festival 2026
events.notes: Citywide across malls and home furnishing stores. The Dubai Media Office 2026 retail calendar lists 16 October to 1 November 2026; the Visit Dubai DHF page headline still shows the 2025 window (3 to 16 October) as of 13 October 2026.

events.name: Dubai Shopping Festival 2026-27
events.notes: 32nd edition. Exact dates not announced by DFRE, DET or Dubai Media Office as of 13 October 2026; the official 2026 retail calendar lists only the 31st edition (5 December 2025 to 11 January 2026). Some travel sites quote 4 December 2026 to 17 January 2027 and attribute it to Visit Dubai, but the official DSF page could not be retrieved to confirm, so no dates are recorded. DSF traditionally runs from early December to mid January.

events.name: World Green Economy Summit 2026
events.operator: World Green Economy Organization (WGEO) with DEWA
events.theme: From Success to Scale: Showcasing the Green Economy
events.venue: Sheikh Rashid Hall, Dubai World Trade Centre

last_refresh_scope: Full review of 2026-10-13: re-verified all 20 records against organiser sites and official government media. Confirmed unchanged: GITEX Global 2026 (7 to 11 December, Summit 7 December, Expo 8 to 11 December, Dubai Exhibition Centre at Expo City Dubai, still upcoming), Expand North Star 2026 (8 to 10 December, DEC Expo City) and Supernova 0X (USD 200K, applications open to 2 November), Dubai Future Week (18 to 21 November), Dubai FinTech Summit (2 to 3 November, Madinat Jumeirah, 4th edition), Dubai AI Festival (26 to 27 October, DWTC), WETEX (20 to 22 October, DWTC, now tagged 28th edition), WGES (21 to 22 October), UN 2026 Water Conference (8 to 10 December, venue added: ADNEC Conference Centre), Dubai Airshow 2027 (15 to 19 November 2027), WGS 2027 (1 to 3 February), AIM Congress 2027 (12 to 14 April), STEP Dubai 2027 (3 to 4 February), DSS 2026 (2 July to 30 August, ended), Esports Festival (held), Home Festival and Festival of Lights. Added Dubai Ride (1 November 2026) to the Dubai Fitness Challenge (31 October to 29 November). No event passed between 28 September and 13 October 2026. Unverified: DSF 2026-27 dates (no official announcement found; third-party 4 December to 17 January claim not confirmed), Dubai Ride and Run dates (press only, organiser site blocks fetches), WGS 2027 venue, AIM Congress 2026 outcomes; the wetex.ae and dubaifitnesschallenge.com sites returned 403 so DEWA and Dubai Media Office pages were used instead.
